term: existing component makes the spacetime whole composite
definition: ExistingComponentsMakeWholeComposite o F ComponentOf Composite w := ∀ x, o.ExistsAt w x → ComponentOf x F.whole → x ≠ F.whole → Composite F.whole. This weak bridge concerns only existing proper components of the selected whole. Case.IsSimple Composite g remains ¬Composite g; it is not replaced by an opaque new simplicity flag or defined as absence of arbitrary Frame parts.
note: Analyst dictionary proposition making the ordinary meaning of a proper composition component explicit at the needed scope. Existing CompositeHasComponentOtherThanItselfReading and CompositeHasTwoDistinctComponentsReading run from Composite to components, and their converses are not silently inferred. If ComponentOf means an intrinsic proper component of a composite, this bridge is part of that intended interpretation; the API alone does not enforce it. The control with component edges but no Composite extension is a formal underconstraint test, outside that intended dictionary, not a serious metaphysical theory with proper components but no composition. No historical attribution or floor adoption is made.
